reviews.title: Everything at the airport was perfect until the actual plane flight. Also app does not work well.
reviews.text: You have more luck with checking in through the website then the app. App only allowed us to check in a couple family members on our fly out but eventually was able to get us all checked in after multiple tries from every single family member attempting to check in themselves and family members trying to check in everyone else. Finally we were able to get everyone checked in . On our way back, we could only get 3 of the 5 family members checked in. We had to wait till we got to the airport to actually check in. Airport was clean, super friendly people. We borded early which was fine but we didn’t have time to get out food before getting on the plane. We decided to order food while on the plane… they ran out of everything. No sandwiches, not even cup of noodles. The plane wasn’t even filled and there were people who did bring on some meals. Your only choices were cookies (that are gross), chips, nachos (sucked-not warmed, too much cheese a little chips), candy, or coffee. So make sure you bring it on food! Also if you like your drinks to be cold, they are served room temperature on the plane. Water bottles/coke cans/ etc will all be warm basically. No menus on the flight. You have to use the app. If you don’t have an iPhone, then you will not be able to open the app and see the menu.
reviews.author: Karina D

reviews.title: Worst airline experience ever
reviews.text: It's to long to detail all the ways this airline lied and ruined our vacation that we didn't end up going on due to this airline, avoid them for all reasons, terrible airline and even worse customer service. They will lie to you over and over and they are nearly impossible to reach for any assistance with issues, ended up trapped in the Tijuana airport due to Volaris lies and negligence.
reviews.author: Ron L

reviews.title: Flight
reviews.text: They stole makeup that I had in one of my bags and also $80 in coins I was taking to my country I don’t recommend this airline honestly
reviews.author: Camila

reviews.title: Worst airline ever, BEWARE!!
reviews.text: Terrible customer service! I could not check in online, tried about 5 times! So I figured I would get my boarding pass at the airport. My flight into Lax was delayed due to bad weather. I did not check my bag, went straight to the gate, they just barely started boarding,There was still 45 minutes left before the plane was supposed to leave, the attendant refused to print my boarding pass, said the flight was closed. I was stranded in LA at midnight!! I had to call a family member in the middle of the night to come pick me up. I tried to get another flight out for the next day and without looking at the computer she told me there was nothing available for the next 3 days!! I will NEVER book a flight with them again, I don't care how cheap they are!!
reviews.author: Irene L

reviews.title: Trash
reviews.text: Worst flight service in the LAX. Only airline to have their flights canceled. 3 flights back to back canceled and the attendant had the nerve to try and offer a reservation for 3 days later…
reviews.author: Carlos B

reviews.title: Made Us Miss Our Flight!
reviews.text: We got the ticket I would say two months before traveling. Everything went smoothly till we got to the airport. On the confirmation letter they told us to get there three hours before our flight. So we did, we had to fill out some paper work, then checked in (which they had trouble doing), then my cousin (16) made her way to the gate, mind you at this point the gate was still open, when she got to the door the police officer wouldn't let her in, telling her she needed a form signed saying she has permission to fly, and that he needed that form because she is a minor. So she had to run back to the front, tell them what the officer said, and they told her to go back and to tell him she doesn't need it. She she went back with the officer, and he told her the same thing, he would not let her board unless she had that paperwork. Okay so they made her back ! She told them again she needed that paper, and they finally gave it after a while!, meanwhile they would leave and come back, talk, and take their time. Once they gave her this paperwork, she ran back to the door, by the point she came back the gate had closed, and the police officer wouldn't let her go in, saying she was late and should have came earlier. She tried her best telling him that he saw her try to get in but they wouldn't let her. So at the end they made her miss her flight, and no refund, and the employees and company blamed it on her saying she should have came 4 hours earlier instead of 3, when in the confirmatio
reviews.author: Katherin L

reviews.title: Do No Use This Airline - Extremely Racist Flight Crew
reviews.text: I will never use Volaris again. I traveled with Volaris May 26, 2023 and May 30, 2023. All flights and customer service was a nightmare. Our first flight was over one hour late which cause us to miss our connecting flight. The airline did not accommodate us or care. I purchased upgraded seats for my husband and I. We were not seated in the upgraded seats. We were scattered apart from each other. I asked the gate agent to please make sure we are seated in the upgraded seat that I paid for. I was laughed at by the rude gate agent and told that I was nothing that he could do. My husband was placed in the back of the plane I was in the middle. The flight crew was racist towards the African American people in the plane. I WILL NEVER TRAVEL WITH SUCH A DESPICABLE AIRLINE AGAIN. All flight attendants on our flight had their ID badge turned so that we could not notate their name to report to corporate. I have a photo of a flight attend that intentional removed her badge during flight so that her identity was not notated due to the rude and racist behavior. THE AIRLINE SHOULD IS A JOKE.
reviews.author: Lisa B

reviews.title: Worst Leg Room in the History
reviews.text: I never leave reviews, but I'm hopping that my message gets across and hopefully one day Volaris can do better. So far, I have travel in every single airline specially the cheap ones (frontier,spirit,viva aerobús, etc) Volaris definitely takes the cake for being the worst. Although they have a decent service, they have the worst leg space ever!! Unless you are 5’0 it will be impossible to have a comfortable Flight in Volaris. I seriously wish to see a change in the future but I doubt it because this Airline will put Profits>People’s comfort
reviews.author: Mario A

reviews.title: Save your money
reviews.text: Terrible treatment after my flight from Puerto Escondido to Cancun got cancelled. The options proposed by the airline included a flight leaving from an airport 100km away in less than 24 hours from the time I was informed about it, flying the next day or flying on the same day but arriving in Cancun at 11pm and literally being stranded at the airport late at night with no way of getting to my already booked accom in Tulum. I spent over an hour on the phone with an employee, who hung up on me after he told me he will transfer me to the supervisor. No possibility of reimbursement for any extra transportation/accom in Cancun for the night I had to pay for. Absolutely terrible customer service online and in person at the airport in Puerto Escondido. No willingness to even listen to me let alone help me. Will never fly with them again.
reviews.author: Unsatisfied customer

reviews.title: Terrible Service Buyer Beware
reviews.text: Booked tickets week in advance to Guatemala from LAX, for my wife, she flew too LAX to catch flight, when I'm trying to check in, its telling me my confirmation code is not valid, call customer service, I'm informed that they cancelled my reservation and can't give me a reason, although they have charged my credit card and charges are posted. Informed customer service and I use that term loosely, that I have a paid reservation, they don't care, and their was space on original flight but they won't book it because it leaves in 4 hours (and it will cost more than double) by the time she landed flight was sold out. They are not willing to do anything about it, but will sell me a ticket for next day for more than double the cost. No cancellation email, no reason, reservation cancelled just hours before trip, spoke to 3 agents 1 supervisor, absolutely terrible customer service. No help at all in resolving problem they created! I will never again book with volaris even if it was free. Cost me additional $700 dollars in last minute flight charges and hotel. Not so much as a sorry, or any other comments. Buyer Beware!! Now I have to fight with them for a refund.
reviews.author: BPak5

reviews.title: Nothing but problems and extra charges.  Will not use Volaris again, the "Spirit" airline of Mexico.
reviews.text: Purchased flight for two from TJ to Los Mochis for a wedding. Also purchased CBX tickets and rental car reservation all through Valaris' website. Itinerary, provided by Volaris, showed arrival time at CBX at 5:30am and flight leaving at 6:22am. Thought that was strange, but figured they knew what they were doing. Arrived at CBX at 5:20 and through the delays of 3 identity checks and lines on the Mexico side (who's trying to break into Mexico!), finally arrived at the Volaris desk at 5:55am and was told that they would not check my two bags and I would have to take another flight with extra charges of course. Next flight was on next day, so I asked to flight to Culiacan instead and was able to book later in the morning for and additional $150 dollars. My experience with US flights is that in the US the airlines generally bend over backwards to make sure passengers don't miss flights. Not Volaris in Mexico, they do their best to put up obstacles and excuses to charge passengers more. In addition to me missing my initial Volaris flight, a party of about 15 family members missed a Volaris flight at the same time as me and could be heard yelling at the Volaris personnel to no avail, they just don't really care. As my situation snowballed, I tried calling the car rental company to either cancel my reservation or transfer it to the new arrival airport in Culiacan. I was then informed that even though my reservation was with "Alamo", the Volaris website uses a third party company nam
reviews.author: Jess F

reviews.title: Don't buy your ticket thinking you can change it
reviews.text: Don't buy the business combo or flexibility or any of the options that allow you to change flight dates. They will make you call in to change the flight, and charge you the "difference" between an old ticket and a new ticket. this is more than the cost of a new ticket!! Customer service is basically like talking to a frustrating robot who have pre-scripted lines and are unable to deviate from the scripts. Its like talking to AI that doesn't really understand you and gives answers that don't inform you of the policies nor help solve a solution. You might save a couple bucks on the fare, but you will more than pay for it in time on the phone, customer service, delays and frustration.
reviews.author: James Z

reviews.title: Volaris - You're the worst airline ever
reviews.text: On the way to Mexico my son, his girlfriend, and her family took Volaris. This was a PM flight, and the pilot "forgot" to put their lights on while flying so other planes could see them. That was just the start. It was a 5 hour flight, and you had to pay for water. My sons girlfriend and her family have flown over 40 times. This is the first time they took Volaris, and will be the last. They all were petrified, and a couple of them were actually crying. 7 days later the day before they were to return, they couldn't find their tickets online. Well Volaris cancelled the flight and did not notify anyone by text, phone, or email. When my son was on the phone with Volaris, they were first saying that none of the group ordered tickets, but an email proved otherwise so there went that. Then Volaris said that the flight was cancelled, and everyone was notified. Yet out of all 5 people, not one received a cancellation of any kind from them. Volaris, instead of refunding them their money offered them each a flight voucher. However, they can not be used the same flight. So my son and his girlfriend couldn't use them on the same flight. BS They asked to speak to the Manager now, and after spending 8 hours just to figure it out everything out and calling back multiple times, it took up most of their last day in Mexico. Finally, Volaris agreed to a refund, but have to wait two weeks. So now my son, and the rest of the group had to cover their flight home, which took money from their spendi

reviews.title: Worst experience ever
reviews.text: I rate them 0 . They ripped my luggage and mixed all my personal belongings. I filled a report. They gave me a number to call , the call Goes to voicemail and one answers me . Never again will I fly with Volaris

The customer service number is an answering machine that hangs up on you. Disgraceful. This airline should be fined. Pay extra and fly a respectable airline.

reviews.title: Airline only cares about making money and not providing good experience for clients
reviews.text: I traveled with my family and I have a special needs son who needs a wheelchair. They made me check in the wheelchair that was normal but didn’t want to provide a wheel chair to pick up my son’s wheelchair after our flight. I had to carry my son from one side of the airport to the other and when we got to baggage claim the wheelchair was not on there either. They made us get out of line and gave us the wheelchair almost heading out of the airport and since we got out of the line we were not able to pick up my vehicle at CBX. I was soooo mad because not only did I have a bad experience at the airport but now I was told I had to get Uber go through border patrol again and then get another Uber to CBX. Worst experience ever and I had to go through it with my two kids and one is special needs. If you can avoid traveling with this airline.

reviews.title: Worse airline, and even worse customer service along with Frontier.
reviews.text: I purchased my flight through volaris website where I paid for my checked bag. The day prior to my flight I tried to check but their website and and iOS app wasn't able to find my reservation. When I showed to frontier to drop off my bag they made me pay again for my check bag. I figure it was a simple miscommunication issue so I thought it would be solved easily. It has been almost three weeks now, Volaris terrible customer service takes ages to reply only to tell me that it was frontier fault, and frontier tells me that it was volaris fault. Is not a huge amount but what bugged me the most is that they want me to accept that they can't give refunds for bags and just suck it up. I'm still going back and fort

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE in Mexico.
reviews.text: I GIVE VOLARIS ZERO STARS!!! Volaris shamelessly steals customers’ money, worst service and very unprofessional staff.
reviews.author: Miguel P

reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: Volaris changed my flight to the next day , I had to contact them to cancel and to get a credit instead because I would not be able to take that alternative flight . The only option given was through WhatsApp ! I started the conversation at 1:00 pm and it would take them anywhere from 2-3 hours to respond back asking for additional information , I would reply back and another 2-3 hours would go by . Finally at 3:00 am I had a full response , 14 hours later ! I stayed up all night because I had to agree with the conditions and terms in order to proceed with the cancelation . Once it was credited I noticed there was an error with the credits . So I had to start another conversation because when I replied back to that same message thread the agent had already closed the conversation (within a minute from their response). The new conversation started at 3:00 am and I did not get a full response until 8:34 am . Unbelievable, I will never book another flight with Volaris that is for sure , customer service is ridiculous .
reviews.author: Neyra

reviews.title: This airline is getting worst and worst
reviews.text: First of all their customer service is trash. I spent a good amount of time trying to speak with an agent only for them to hang up on me when they answered. Their WhatsApp customer service is a scam they said my fathers flight included a carry on only to pay extra at the airport because it was not included. They also changed my flight and was told I would received 25% back for the inconvenience. Well haven’t heard a thing about that, still waiting. My luggage was damaged upon arrival the handle was torn off and of course they won’t do anything about it. Very disappointed will be swinging airlines.

reviews.title: Rude Agents and Careless Baggage Handling
reviews.text: Paid the baggage fee for a Bicycle to be checked onto the plane only to be charged more when I checked in and then to have the bike box crushed and left in T.J. - Was in town for an Ironman event and finally got the bike delivered to me at 2am and it was inoperable. I filed a claim and I followed up with them when I returned. They asked me for an estimate which I provided and now nobody will return my calls...just perfect.
reviews.author: Greg R

reviews.title: Customer service nightmare
reviews.text: Unwilling to change itinerary not even acting to care. Chatbots on Facebook and whatsapp designed to keep you in loop forever with no chance to have things resolved properly. Customer service agent applying the same technique - letting me fade out in the loop after telling me to 'redirect' me.
reviews.author: teftliefel

reviews.title: Volaris stole my money. They do not answer me now.
reviews.text: Their strategy overselling the flights. Then, from there there are tons of excuses to not give you the money back. After 3 months , I never got the money back and a nobody care after you give them your money. They oversold my flight to CMDX. For that I lost the International flight. I lost the money for both. I created multiple tickets and after few hours they usually close them. Please Never, Never buy with Volaris. Full of bad surprises.
reviews.author: Cesar G

reviews.title: worst airline
reviews.text: Terrible airline, I only booked because it was a direct flight from CDMX to Sacramento CA. But I will never fly again Volaris. When you book your ticket you enter your first, middle, and last name. Well the company took my middle name and changed it to be my last name so of course it did not match my passport as my middle name is different from my last name. During the check in process (24 hrs before my flight) I noticed this and called the customer service number and they informed me that I am unable process this change due to this being 24 hrs after I purchased my ticket. I am well versed in how to book and purchase flights using my middle name and last name. Volaris has a problem in their web site on middle names. I put up a fight and asked them to cancel my entire trip since I wouldn't be able to board due to their site having an issue with the correct name. They transferred me to manager who assured me that he could change the name but there would be an additional charge. I agreed to the extra charge and waited ten minutes on hold for them t process my payment. I have confirmation when I purchased my ticket and my name was correctly spelled first middle initial and last name. Again, this airline is corrupt and charges for even the air you breath. If you can avoid them at all costs, do not fly a corrupt airline. This will be the second and last time I fly Volaris. Also I paid for a seat upgrade (first row) and it was as if I was sitting on a wooden board for a 4 hour flig
reviews.author: Ryan B

reviews.title: Volaris is a corrupt and crooked airline
reviews.text: Traveling from OAK to Leon Mexico for a wedding . Volaris cancelled both my outbound and return flight . And rebooked it for 2 days later . Scrambling to find out what I was going to do , I had to change the return flight to LAX , Volaris charged me $600 for this ! Absolutely ridiculous . Horrible airline with horrible customer service . Will never fly this airline again .

reviews.title: WORST MEXICAN AIRLINE
reviews.text: I booked one month ago my round flight from Guanajuato to Tijuana. Yesterday I received a mail mentioning that my flight to TIJ was canceled. In the call center OF COURSE they couldn´t fix the situation, since I booked from one specific day to another. They say they have the "responsability" of taking me to my destination, but in the time and day they want, not the one I payed for. I am now canceling all the trip since the days they want me to flight, are not working for me, but of course they are not going to pay for reservations made. They ofered me 25% of compensation in a voucher that you need to use with them to have the oportunity to SCAM you again. In this point I do not even expect to receive it, I just hope to have my money back (in a period of 7 to 21 days as per their policy) Guys really, if you don't your trip to be screw, do not use Volaris. This is the worst mexican airline for a reason (FY Volaris!)

reviews.title: Terrible!!
reviews.text: Yesterday we were supposed to fly back to LAX (they ended up canceling our flight) They told us our suitcases were “too big” we took a measuring tape when we bought them and it was the size that the Website was telling us. Apparently they measure in cm here but that information was no where to be seen online. They made us pay extra money just for that. They charge money for every little thing because that’s all they care about. The Money!! Volaris is just a scam. They have poor customer service and very rude employees aswell…

There are charges after you book whether you used all the credit or not SCAM !!!! WORSE AIRLINE EVER! IF YOU DON'T USED THE E-CREDIT YOU LOSE IT

reviews.text: YA VAS + VOLARIS = ANOTHER WAY TO SCAM!!! DO NOT USE THEIR YA VAS SITE, they are scamming people with the old BAIT AND SWITCH, I went into their web page YA VAS to book a flight/hotel package, after reading their rule and cancellation policy decide to make the booking, I chose the Hotel and the flight according to my needs, a flight departing from Ontario, Ca to Guadalajara, Mex, the time chosen was to depart at 00:47 on sat May 6th arriving the same day at 4:47 am,( need to be there for Saturday event) returning on May 8th, I do travel frequent and I know better to make sure to select the correct flight!, So I triple check the correct flight was selected with my wife sitting next to me and took a picture of the selected itinerary, so after clicking yes to the payment I received the confirmation, I noticed right away that the outgoing flight was CHANGED to a different time !!!! The Departure time we were assigned now was to depart at 19:30 pm arriving at 23;30 on May 6th.
